rationale: The examples point to a simple two-stage fit: preserve source cells and extend their colors along all eight rays, then repeat tiles in a 2-by-2 arrangement. With stop policy 0, rays run to the boundary; setting paint to no positive value makes each ray retain its source color. Tile orientation varies by tile position, using identity, horizontal flip, vertical flip, and 180-degree rotation across the four positions. This yields a concrete hypothesis while leaving unneeded tensor entries at a consistent low value.
